Subject: NebulaCore security intake: schedule & evidence cadence

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks for considering Redwood for this piece of work. We'd like to kick off a short intake call to align on scope (SIG vs CAIQ vs SOC2 sampling), attack surface, and evidence handoff cadence so we can size a runbook for your auditor. Suggested agenda:

- Quick intros (5m)
- Confirm questionnaire type(s) and must-have controls (5m)
- Evidence inventory & owners (10m)
- Log/sample extraction window and redaction expectations (10m)
- Next steps & timeline (5m)

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue 26 May, 10:00–10:30
- Wed 27 May, 09:00–09:30
- Wed 27 May, 15:00–15:30

If none of those work, tell me a couple of 30m slots that do.

For prep, could you drop the following into the Drive link below ahead of the call (or attach to a reply)?
- Primary SIG/CAIQ/SOC2 questionnaire (if you already have a populated draft)
- High-level network diagram (PDF fine)
- A point of contact for log/sample exports (name + email)

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AabcDEF12345ghi
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0191

Thanks — we can do Wed 27 May 09:00–09:30 PT. I sent Tom on this thread; he'll join with our security lead.

I've attached:
- NebulaCore_SIG_Questions_v1.xlsx (master SIG with a few prefilled answers)
- NebulaCore_Network_Diagram.pdf (high-level diagram)

Two quick notes:
1) We plan to run SIG first (customer request) but may also need a CAIQ export for our cloud procurement team — we can discuss which artifacts to produce during the call.
2) For log samples: we will likely provide a timeboxed export (48–72 hours). Our policy team asks if you can confirm redaction guidance (PII removal) up front so we scope extraction appropriately.

See you on Wed 09:00 PT.

Cheers,
